chunks: "Whoever combs his beard seventy times and counts it one by one, Shaytan will not approach him for forty days."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about combing the beard seventy times?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes a protective effect against Shaytan to a specific act of grooming performed with care and count. It reflects teachings on cleanliness, personal etiquette, and embodied practices connected with spiritual well-being.
